propositions: Container decomposition via layer-cake architectural partitioning (DB/service/frontend children) passes existing G3/G4 criteria but violates decomposition SHAPE because children are not independently shippable and defer integration risk to the end.

Children that consume artifacts (output files, schemas, events) from sibling producers without explicit ordering dependencies (depends_on/blocks edges) create a high-signal producer→consumer-without-edge shape smell that existing G4 criteria do not specifically target.

A new advisory, AGENT-tier, CONTAINER criterion named decomp-shape must be added to detect both decomposition-shape smells by auditing the (parent, children, sibling-roster) decomposition structure via the existing pass1_container fan-out without new engine constructs.

The decomp-shape criterion ships as non-blocking advisory (never blocks promotions) with promotion to blocking deferred until dogfood-gated effectiveness validation AND E6's order-stability (fleiss_kappa) clears floor prerequisite (currently failed at 0.55 < 0.6).

Bounded sanity evaluation with four hand-authored fixtures (layer-cake positive, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge positive, vertical-slice negative, ordered producer/consumer negative) must achieve recall 1.0 on positives and false-accept 0.0 on negatives.
